Gastrointestinal endoscopy for dogs

Endoscopy lets us look inside the oesophagus, stomach and upper intestine without open surgery, and take biopsies in the same session. In brachycephalic dogs it matters because chronic regurgitation is often a gastrointestinal problem sitting alongside the airway problem.

Does my bulldog need endoscopy before airway surgery?

A hiatal hernia or a sliding oesophagus shows up on endoscopy and changes the anaesthetic plan for airway surgery, so we scope bulldogs with persistent regurgitation before the soft palate procedure rather than after it. The two findings together explain most cases that do not improve.
